NuclearBoundC90.genuineConvolution_lift_pair_lower_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (μ : Measure (GenuineClasses K)) (φ u v : GenuineClasses K → ℂ) (x : GenuineClasses K)
  (hu : Integrable (fun g => φ g * u (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) (hv : Integrable (fun g => φ g * v (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) :
  2 * ‖genuineConvolution K μ φ v x‖ ≤
    ‖genuineConvolution K μ φ (fun y => u y + v y) x‖ + ‖genuineConvolution K μ φ (fun y => u y - v y) x‖

NuclearBoundC90.smoothedLift_finite_cost.{u_2, u_3} {H : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
  {ι : Type u_3} (J : Finset ι) (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (u : ι → H) (v : H) (η : ι → H →L[ℂ] ℂ) (c : ℝ)
  (hη : ∀ i ∈ J, c ≤ ‖η i‖) : 2 * ↑J.card * ‖A v‖ * c ≤ ∑ i ∈ J, (‖A (u i + v)‖ * ‖η i‖ + ‖A (u i - v)‖ * ‖η i‖)

NuclearBoundC90.quotientLift_pair_cost.{u_2} {H : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H] (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
  (M : Submodule ℂ H) (u v : H) (hv : v ∈ M) (η : H →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
  M.mkQ (u + v) = M.mkQ u ∧ M.mkQ (u - v) = M.mkQ u ∧ 2 * ‖A v‖ * ‖η‖ ≤ ‖A (u + v)‖ * ‖η‖ + ‖A (u - v)‖ * ‖η‖
NuclearBoundC90.genuineWeightedLift_pair_cost.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (μ : Measure (GenuineClasses K)) (w : GenuineClasses K → ℝ≥0∞)
  (A : ↥(WeightedSpace K μ w) →L[ℂ] ↥(WeightedSpace K μ w)) (M : Submodule ℂ ↥(WeightedSpace K μ w))
  (u v : ↥(WeightedSpace K μ w)) (hv : v ∈ M) (η : ↥(WeightedSpace K μ w) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :
  M.mkQ (u + v) = M.mkQ u ∧ M.mkQ (u - v) = M.mkQ u ∧ 2 * ‖A v‖ * ‖η‖ ≤ ‖A (u + v)‖ * ‖η‖ + ‖A (u - v)‖ * ‖η‖

NuclearBoundC90.genuineConvolution_lift_pair_lower_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (μ : Measure (NuclearBoundC90.GenuineClasses K)) (φ u v : NuclearBoundC90.GenuineClasses K → ℂ)
  (x : NuclearBoundC90.GenuineClasses K) (hu : Integrable (fun g => φ g * u (g⁻¹ * x)) μ)
  (hv : Integrable (fun g => φ g * v (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) :
  2 * ‖NuclearBoundC90.genuineConvolution K μ φ v x‖ ≤
